engineer/Work/Atlas/Ops.manual: Deployments, incidents, monitoring and infrastructure for Atlas, including operational security and availability.

engineer/Work/Ref/Web.manual: Reusable browser, CSS and accessibility documentation without Atlas-specific implementation work.

engineer/Learn/ML/NLP.manual: Language models, text embeddings and retrieval experiments for personal learning, rather than Atlas production incidents.

engineer/Life/Bike/Trips.manual: Cycling routes, GPX tracks and practical ride planning, rather than equipment shopping.

engineer/Life/Buy/Books.manual: Books and ebooks to buy or read, including technical books; interactive tutorials go in learning or references.

engineer/Life/Buy/Tech.manual: Personal electronics and computer accessory purchases, rather than cycling equipment or work implementation.

household/Rodzina/Zdrowie.manual: Family appointments, preventive health information and medical visit preparation.

household/Wyjazdy/2027/Berlin.manual: Practical planning for the family Berlin trip: accommodation, local transport, visits and reservations.

household/Wyjazdy/Pomysły.manual: Inspiration for future trips without an active destination plan; material specifically for Berlin goes in its trip folder.

household/Kupić/Ubrania.manual: Clothes and shoes for the family, including school and travel clothing purchases.

household/Czytanie/Książki.manual: Books and ebooks to read or buy, including travel, food and parenting books.

household/Gotowanie/Obiady.manual: Recipes and practical meal plans to cook at home, including family lunchbox meals.

designer/Clients/Maple/Brand.manual: Maple client identity: logo, palette, packaging and print materials, separate from Orbit and website behavior.

designer/Clients/Maple/Web.manual: Maple ecommerce site navigation, product pages, checkout and implementation handoff.

designer/Studio/Ref/Type.manual: Reusable typeface, typography and lettering references not committed to a specific client.

designer/Studio/Ref/UX.manual: Reusable interaction design and accessibility research, independent of a client deliverable.

designer/Firma/Admin/PL.manual: Polish freelance invoices, contracts, taxes and administration, regardless of the language of the source.

designer/Firma/Admin/DE.manual: German freelance invoicing, tax and business administration, regardless of the source language.

designer/Osobiste/Foto/Sprzęt.manual: Camera and lens purchases, compatibility and maintenance, rather than photo locations.

designer/Osobiste/Foto/Plenery.manual: Places and routes for personal photo walks, access notes and light conditions.
